name: @acme/vue-app
description: A Vue application on ACME's design system, as a product team would write it: a form of acme-text-field bound with v-model, and an assistant whose agent sends its interface with A2UI (ADR 0052). Built and tested against the archives of ACME and the base: run `npm run example` from the repository root. `overrides` points ACME's dependencies to the base's archives, which a registry would provide.
